mapper.select: SELECT id, name, created_at, updated_at FROM tag ORDER BY id
SELECT t.id, t.name, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM tag t INNER JOIN media_tag mt ON mt.tag_id = t.id WHERE mt.media_id = #{mediaId} ORDER BY t.id
SELECT id, name, created_at, updated_at FROM tag WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tag (name, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, NOW(), NOW())
INSERT IGNORE INTO media_tag (media_id, tag_id) VALUES (#{mediaId}, #{tagId})
